question: In a certain code language, 'FASHION' is written as 'NISFAHO'. How will 'BLANKET' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'FASHION' is written as 'NISFAHO'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7e38a1ccd92424613045b06a6ba391b352bc178db2de681b8118cc0ab6690ee.png] 

Similarly,

'BLANKET' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23f981c853275246b7a499d92e0003d9000ccbea16c6892b4f177a3f1c1fe51d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TKABLNE".**
